name: states
title: States
description: Screen states that never lie: LoadingState (spinner or skeleton, busy, label for screen readers), ErrorState (alert, retry, collapsible details) and DataState, which picks loading, error, empty or your content from a status and never shows empty while pending or after an error.
docs: One item, three components (`error-state`, `loading-state`, `data-state`), since DataState renders the other two and Empty by default. `<DataState status data error onRetry labels={{ errorTitle, retry, emptyTitle }}>{(data) => …}</DataState>` works with any data library: map its status to `pending`, `error` or `success`. Visible copy has no default: the types require `errorTitle` and `emptyTitle` (and `retry` with `onRetry`) unless you pass `renderError` and `empty`. `loading` and `refreshing` are screen-reader labels and default to English. While a refetch is pending, the last data stays on screen with `aria-busy` and a small spinner (`keepPreviousData`, default true); pass `fetching` for libraries whose status stays `success` during a refetch. `isEmpty` decides what counts as empty (an empty array, `null` or `undefined` by default). Every state takes `size`: `inline`, `panel` (default) or `page`.
